steps.name: Zeno's Relay
steps.objective: Go to [Ellie] in the “Chunsik Land Lobby”.

steps.name: Doll's street cleaning!
steps.objective: Defeat [Peace Symbol Finn] and [Heart Pirates Navigator] in “Doll Street” and report to [Ellie] in “Chunsik Land Lobby”.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Welcome to Chunsik Land, full of dreams and hopes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Excuse me... Who are you?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Are you a construction official?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here at Zenon’s request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They say it needs to be sorted out... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh, that rumored Adventurer?!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh my, oh my oh my!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I thought it was just a three-headed muscular monster... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You look cute! Hehehe~!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of rumors are being spread about me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I have a lot of work to do, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I would be grateful if you could let me know what you are doing as soon as possible!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Be harsh. So it's cuter.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: What you need to do is simple.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: They say there was magic in this place... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Because of that, the sculptures and characters are moving.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Because of the chaos, we can't work on reopening.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that… There were still some left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, are you planning to remodel and reopen Chunsik Land?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, that's my role.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: At first, we attempted to negotiate over the hiring of full-time employees... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I was completely ignored!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I can't do this all alone in this condition.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're asking for help, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how do we create moving character sculptures?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Drive it to one side, tie it so it can't move... .

steps.name: Memorial Outlaws 1
steps.objective: Defeat [Knight of Light Bong Chun-sik] at the "Chunsik Land Memorial Hall" and report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Could you please do that first?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I've met many visitors, but this is the first time someone has said that!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There was no one willing to do that like Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's amazing. You handle so many character sculpts... . It will take a few more days for me to do that.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You have great work skills. Are you interested in Chunsik Land? What is it like working here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'll just finish with the request.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just kidding. Anyway, now you just need to clean up the memorial hall.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's such a disgusting place that I don't even want to go in.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Where did so many ugly and strange characters come from? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, how did you end up working at a place like this?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: One day, the owner came to where I was working and suggested a job change.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The salary was good... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Above all, he said he would not interfere with the work and would provide all necessary support.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those are great conditions!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's right. So, without realizing it, I signed the fluttering contract… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Anyway, please hurry up and clean up the Chunsik Land Memorial Hall.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We're going to clean up the inside and fill it with new attractions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It's not that difficult... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Memorial Outlaws 2
steps.objective: Defeat [Beat Music Troupe] and [Fairy Bear Strong] at the “Chunsik Land Memorial Hall” and report to [Ellie] in the “Chunsik Land Lobby”.

steps.name: Memorial Outlaws 3
steps.objective: Defeat [Bong], [Chun], and [Sik] at the "Chunsik Land Memorial Hall" and report to [Ellie] in the "Chunsik Land Lobby".

steps.name: Ice Cream Garden Cleaning 1
steps.objective: Report the [Three-Piece Snowball Character Set] from “Ice Cream Garden” to [Ellie] in the “Chunsik Land Lobby.”

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You cleaned up the Bong Chun-sik special forces unit very cleanly.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: First of all, it would be better to end the memorial hall like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still more things to sweep away... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I think it would be a good idea to get rid of the large items first.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now, next is the ice cream garden.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The concept was good considering what the owner had planned... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm trying to improve the quality by pouring in more ideas.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But as expected, the characters there are causing trouble... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just need to clean up there too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Only the big ones?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's it. There is no need to worry about the little details.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Please organize only the large items.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You can collect small things and organize them all at once.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's what cleaning is supposed to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Anyway, they are characters that are alive and moving.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're trash, you're too cold-hearted.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If you didn't want to be treated like that, you should have at least pretended to be serious about my negotiation plan.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It wasn't like I was going to ring a bell at a cheap price.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The conditions were so good, but they completely ignored them!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Why are you so angry at me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: Ice Cream Garden Cleaning 2
steps.objective: Report the [Petite Milky Way character set of three] to [Ellie] in the “Chunsik Land Lobby” at “Ice Cream Garden”.3

steps.name: Ice cream garden cleaning 3
steps.objective: Defeat [Ancient Calorie] in “Ice Cream Garden” and report to [Ellie] in “Chunsik Land Lobby”.

steps.name: Book of Shadows Cleaning 1
steps.objective: Defeat all [Three-Piece Set] drawn by Bong Chun-sik in “Book of Shadows.”

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now only the Book of Shadows remains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It’s like the owner’s personal library… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Is that also a magic or a curse... Anyway, there was an uproar due to a strange trick.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Well, if I had to describe the place in one word... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To express it… .?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Would you say that it is a place where all the dark history is covered?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It seems to me that the owner thinks it's a treasure trove.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: When you go in, all kinds of books and pictures are flying around.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Besides, isn’t the dragon in the second-highest level setting too noisy? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? A sick dragon in middle school?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You'll find out when you go.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Please clean up there too.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Clean. Clean.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's a dirty place full of graffiti disguised as art!

steps.name: Book of Shadows Cleaning 2
steps.objective: Defeat all [Graffiti Bug Three Set] created by Bong Chun-sik in “Book of Shadows.”

steps.name: Book of Shadows Cleaning 3
steps.objective: Please rest in peace to the character [Dark Flame Lord Black Flame Dragon] created by Bong Chun-sik in “The Book of Shadows.”

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: As expected, you are sure to get the job done.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: In fact, Detective Zenon recommended Adventurer and praised it so much that it made my mouth water.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: He said that although we worked together on many things, he never made a single mistake... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Anyway, thanks to this, we can now proceed with the reopening of Chunsik Land in earnest.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just completed the request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I was thinking while I was working, why not change my name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chunsik Land… Isn’t it too old-fashioned?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I thought so too... The owner is adamant about that.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: He said he had no intention of changing even if a knife was put to his throat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Still, if the content and service are good, many people will visit!

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh, when the adventure is over and you have nothing else to do, come visit us.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll hire you on good terms! Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your words.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But, there's still work to do.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have someone to meet. I don't know when we can meet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'm busy, so I'll just leave.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes! Take care back home!
